articles.title: Water purifier maker Kent RO delays IPO as Mideast war dents sentiment
articles.content: Kent RO Systems has postponed its stock market debut. The Indian water purifier maker cites global market volatility, worsened by the Iran conflict, as the reason. Rising costs for raw materials also impact operations. The company will reassess its IPO plans in at least a year. Despite challenges, Kent expects revenue growth driven by low water purifier adoption in India.

articles.title: ​How TSMC and AI mania helped Taiwan leapfrog India in global equity rankings
articles.content: ​Taiwan has overtaken India to become the world’s fifth-largest stock market, driven by a massive rally in semiconductor giant TSMC amid the global artificial intelligence boom. Strong investor demand for AI-linked infrastructure and advanced chip manufacturing has reshaped global equity rankings and redirected capital towards technology-heavy markets.​

articles.title: Sri Lanka jolts markets with outsized 100-bp rate hike to counter Gulf crisis
articles.content: Sri Lanka's central bank enacted a significant 100 basis point policy rate hike, its largest in four years, to combat rising inflation and a weakening rupee. This move comes as the nation grapples with soaring energy prices driven by the Middle East conflict, impacting economic growth and foreign reserves.

articles.title: Indian bonds choppy as oil reverses course putting focus back on US-Iran issues
articles.content: Indian government bond yields edged higher in early trading Tuesday, influenced by renewed U.S.-Iran tensions that pushed oil prices up. This development reversed the support from softer Treasury yields, creating a choppy market environment. Traders anticipate a narrow trading range for bonds, with Friday's auction potentially swaying sentiment.

articles.title: Aditya Shah calls for complete removal of LTCG for foreign investors amid FPI outflows
articles.content: Aditya Shah of Hercules Advisors urges India to abolish its long-term capital gains tax on equities for foreign investors, arguing it deters crucial portfolio inflows. He contends that removing the tax is the only credible signal to attract foreign capital, which is vital for lowering the cost of capital and deepening markets.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Bond yields drop after Trump signals progress in Iran talks
articles.content: Treasury yields declined as optimism around a US-Iran agreement boosted demand for government bonds. Softer oil prices eased inflation concerns, reducing pressure on the Federal Reserve to maintain aggressive monetary policy. However, market caution persisted following reports of US and Israeli strikes on Iranian vessels.

articles.title: Global Market: Chinese AI and chip stocks rally after Huawei signals major tech leap
articles.content: Chinese semiconductor stocks surged in Hong Kong following Huawei's announcement of a potential 1.4nm chip breakthrough using "LogicFolding" technology by 2031. This development aims to narrow the gap with global leaders and bolster China's AI ambitions amid US restrictions. While promising, the technology's commercial viability remains to be seen, with a key test expected with upcoming Kirin mobile chips.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Kevin Warsh’s Fed debut signals major shift in US monetary policy landscape
articles.content: President Donald Trump now directly influences US economic policy with Kevin Warsh leading the Federal Reserve. This change comes as inflation rises and consumer confidence falls. articles.title: Suzlon Energy shares rise after Q4 results. What are Motilal Oswal, Nuvama saying?
